text:
lina: heads up — local mkdocs build showed a bunch of broken anchors after the image-caption reflow PR. getting 'Fragment not found: #getting-started-usage' on several pages. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123

sam: i saw that earlier. looks like MDX rendering merged the caption and the following bullet when a linewrap happened. reproduced locally with mkdocs 1.5 + mkdocs-material. repro steps in the PR description.

felix: can you paste the minimal md snippet that triggers it?

lina: sure — minimal example i used:

```mdx
![diagram](./arch.png)
small caption without blank line
- point one
- point two
```

run: mkdocs build --strict
error: Linkcheck failed: Fragment not found: #getting-started-usage

docs-ci: automated test failed for branch=docs/reflow-image-caption — 27 broken fragments, 2 missing image assets. full log: https://ci.redwood.example/build/9821

mike: quick mitigation: ensure a blank line between the caption and the list, or prefer semantic figure/figcaption markup. but we should fix source examples so future PRs dont reintroduce this.

sam: agree. i'll open a tiny follow-up PR that inserts a blank line in the examples and adds a comment in the mdx snippet explaining the quirk. i'll run linkcheck locally before pushing. assigning to me.

lina: nice. also can we add a short note in docs/contributing/mdx-guidelines.md about this behavior (blank line vs figcaption) so writers know?

docs-ci: re-run will be triggered after PR merge; tagging build-owner @docs-ci to queue.

felix: one more thing — docusaurus and mkdocs handle trailing colons and paragraph merges differently. might be worth a small section in the migration guide showing both runtimes and the safe patterns.

mike: good call. i'll add a section under docs/migration/mdx-rendering-quirks.md with examples for both.

lina: sweet. summary: sam will PR the example fixes + comment, mike will add migration note, felix will sweep other pages for similar wrap issues. ping here when CI green. :thumbsup:
